attributes.class: =if(@currentField == 'New', 'sp-field-severity--low', if(@currentField == 'Sent to Jira', 'sp-field-severity--low', if(@currentField == 'In progress', 'sp-field-severity--low', if(@currentField == 'Waiting on you', 'sp-field-severity--warning', if(@currentField == 'Done', 'sp-field-severity--good', if(@currentField == 'Declined', 'sp-field-severity--severeWarning', ''))))))

attributes.iconName: =if(@currentField == 'New', 'CircleRing', if(@currentField == 'Sent to Jira', 'Send', if(@currentField == 'In progress', 'Forward', if(@currentField == 'Waiting on you', 'Contact', if(@currentField == 'Done', 'CheckMark', if(@currentField == 'Declined', 'Cancel', ''))))))
